page_title: LEN 3-1 BRE | Lens v Brest 29/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

90+7' Saud Abdulhamid (Lens) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Gregoire Coudert pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going inside the right-hand post. Good work from Lens as they win a corner.
90+3' Today's match ends for Wesley Said who will be replaced by Florian Sotoca (Lens).

90+2' 3 - 1 Adrien Thomasson (Lens) latches on to a precise pass deep inside the box from Saud Abdulhamid, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low accurate shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 3:1.
90+1' 6 additional min. will be played.
86' Eric Roy has decided to make a change. Raphael Le Guen (Brest) replaces Bradley Locko.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joris Chotard trots off the pitch and is replaced by Serigne Diop (Brest).
85' A dangerous towering header by Mamadou Sangare (Lens) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
84' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) takes the corner.
84' Half-chance! Anthony Bermont (Lens) plays a pass into the box, but Gregoire Coudert reacts well to snuff out the attack. The ball is out of play. Lens win a corner kick.
82' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

78' 2 - 1 Goal! Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. Gregoire Coudert is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 2:1.
78' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
77' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
77' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Saud Abdulhamid (Lens) will replace Ruben Aguilar.
76' Florian Thauvin goes off the pitch and Anthony Bermont (Lens) comes on.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rayan Fofana leaves the pitch and Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) comes on.
75' Eric Roy prepares a substitution. Mama Balde is replaced by Hamidou Makalou (Brest).
75' Justin Bourgault (Brest) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Kamory Doumbia.
69' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
68' Florian Thauvin (Lens) takes the corner which is cleared.

68' Matthieu Udol (Lens) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting corner and steers his header into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him. The ball goes behind for a corner. Lens will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
67' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) will take the corner.
66' Florian Thauvin (Lens) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
64' Samson Baidoo (Lens) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the bottom right corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
63' Florian Thauvin (Lens) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

63' A pass into the box finds Rayan Fofana (Lens) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the left side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Gregoire Coudert denies him. The ball goes out of play. Lens are awarded a corner kick.
60' 1 - 1 Goal! Gregoire Coudert gets a hand on the penalty from Florian Thauvin (Lens), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom right corner.
60' Florian Thauvin (Lens) is going to take the penalty!
60' The Lens players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
60' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Lens! Let's see what he decides.
59' Eric Roy has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gregoire Coudert (Brest) replacing Romain Del Castillo.
57' The referee can't ignore those comments and Kenny Lala (Brest) sees a yellow card for bad language.
55' Radoslaw Majecki (Brest) is sent off after deserving nothing other than a red card from a referee for clattering into his opponent!
52' Matthieu Udol (Lens) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post.
50' Florian Thauvin (Lens) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal.
48' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
46' That will be all from Deiver Machado who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Samson Baidoo (Lens).
46' Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+2' Rayan Fofana (Lens) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the right side of the goal. It's a great effort but an even better save from Radoslaw Majecki, who tips the ball around the post.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
42' Florian Thauvin (Lens) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
41' A header by Wesley Said (Lens) from very close range goes towards the crossbar, but doesn't get past Radoslaw Majecki, who makes a brilliant save.
41' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Florian Thauvin (Lens) took the corner.
40' Referee Abdelatif Kherradji signals NO PENALTY for Lens after a VAR review!

39' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Lens.
38' Florian Thauvin (Lens) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
36' Mama Balde (Brest) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
34' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
34' Deiver Machado (Lens) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
31' Florian Thauvin (Lens) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Radoslaw Majecki.
30' Florian Thauvin (Lens) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
29' Adrien Thomasson slides a brilliant pass into Rayan Fofana (Lens), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker wide of the right post.
27' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
24' 0 - 1 Goal! Kamory Doumbia shows great vision to find Mama Balde (Brest) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 0:1.

23' Rayan Fofana (Lens) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the right post.
21' Florian Thauvin (Lens) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
19' Florian Thauvin (Lens) pounces on a loose pass, cuts inside an opponent and unleashes a piledriver towards goal. The keeper scrambles to save the effort, but it rises just over the bar.
14' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) whips in a vicious corner direct on goal, but the keeper makes a confident catch on the line.
14' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
12' Joris Chotard (Brest) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked. The ball goes out of play and Brest have been awarded a corner kick.

8' Florian Thauvin (Lens) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
7' Florian Thauvin (Lens) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
6' Malang Sarr (Lens) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. Lens will take a corner kick.
6' Florian Thauvin (Lens) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
5' Florian Thauvin (Lens) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

4' Florian Thauvin (Lens) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lens will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Brest will kick the game off.
Abdelatif Kherradji is introduced as the referee for today's match.
